instType: Public research university; public corporate body established by law
language: English — all courses and the complete degree are taught in English
entry: A university entrance qualification (UEQ) giving direct access to German undergraduate study is mandatory; documents are assessed only after a complete application.
ib: NOT PUBLISHED — no programme-specific IB cutoff; the diploma must constitute a direct German university entrance qualification.
alevel: NOT PUBLISHED — no programme-specific A-Level grades; recognised GCE Advanced Level routes must constitute a direct German university entrance qualification.
cbse: NOT PUBLISHED — no CBSE percentage. India route: Class 12 certificate plus either one successful year of recognised higher education in computer science OR IIT JEE Main and Advanced, with APS certificate.
isc: NOT PUBLISHED — no ISC percentage. India route: Class 12 certificate plus either one successful year of recognised higher education in computer science OR IIT JEE Main and Advanced, with APS certificate.
other: Choose exactly one route: recognised science/informatics/mathematics olympiad + English test; accepted aptitude test + English test + video interview; or motivation letter + two-day online/on-site interview route. SAT, TestAS, digital TestAS, ACT, Gaokao, JEE Advanced and Suneung are accepted for the aptitude route; no fixed cutoff, ranking applies.
english: Olympiad/aptitude routes: IELTS Academic, TOEFL iBT, TOEFL Essentials, Cambridge or PTE Academic. Native-speaker waiver only for high-school diplomas from Australia, Canada, Ireland, New Zealand, UK or USA. Interview route does not require a separate English test. Minimum English-test score: NOT PUBLISHED.
selection: Admission restricted and competitive: UEQ grade plus route result determine a ranking; the best N candidates are admitted. The programme states 15 seats per year.
deadline: Winter 2027/28 intake is officially announced; its schedule will be published when the portal opens in December 2026. 2026 reference dates: 15 Jan and 15 Jun preliminary deadlines; 15 Jul final deadline (interview route by 15 Jun); final decisions by 31 Aug.
feeEU: No tuition. OFFICIAL-SOURCE CONTRADICTION: current university fee page states €412.30 for winter 2026/27; the official SIC programme page states €394.30 per semester.
feeNonEU: No tuition. OFFICIAL-SOURCE CONTRADICTION: current university fee page states €412.30 for winter 2026/27; the official SIC programme page states €394.30 per semester.
liveLo: OFFICIAL-SOURCE CONTRADICTION: Saarland University estimates around €800/month.
liveHi: OFFICIAL-SOURCE CONTRADICTION: the official SIC programme page estimates about €900/month.
scholarships: Competitive Deutschlandstipendium: €300/month for one year; other official schemes may also be available.
visa: EU citizens are exempt from the pre-travel student-visa requirement; other students generally apply to the responsible German mission before travelling, subject to official nationality-specific exceptions.
apply: Apply through the mandatory Saarland Informatics Campus online form; email and hard-copy applications are not accepted. uni-assist/VPD is not required. Application fee: NOT PUBLISHED.
notes: No prior German is required. The study regulations list a 6-credit language course that may be German or English, so the degree can still be completed in English. Two unresolved official-source contradictions remain: semester fee (€412.30 vs €394.30) and living estimate (€800 vs €900).
exact_quote: All courses are taught in English
documents_required: Identity card or passport, Higher education entrance qualification, Academic transcripts and degree certificates,Curriculum Vitae, Letter of motivation / SOP,Proof of language proficiency,Certified translations

instType: Public university; statutory corporation and Bavarian state institution
language: English — the complete programme can be completed in English
entry: German-equivalent general or technology subject-restricted university entrance qualification plus English B2; extra aptitude-test rules depend on citizenship and where the school qualification was earned.
ib: NOT PUBLISHED — no programme-specific IB points cutoff. A qualifying IB diploma is assessed for German-equivalent general/technology university entry; a qualifying IB route does not require the aptitude test.
alevel: NOT PUBLISHED — no programme-specific A-Level grades. UK/non-EEA school-system applicants must have a qualifying university entrance certificate and, where the stated route applies, one accepted aptitude test.
cbse: NOT PUBLISHED — no CBSE percentage. Applicants who are not EU citizens and earned the qualification outside the EEA need a qualifying university entrance certificate plus one accepted aptitude test.
isc: NOT PUBLISHED — no ISC percentage. Applicants who are not EU citizens and earned the qualification outside the EEA need a qualifying university entrance certificate plus one accepted aptitude test.
other: For the applicable non-EEA route, one is rigidly required: SAT 1240+, TestAS percentile 80+, ACT 25+, JEE Main NTA 80+, JEE Advanced qualified, or CSAT Grade 3 or better. No waiver except the officially stated qualifying routes, including qualifying IB or a completed recognised EEA degree.
english: B2 CEFR. Accepted examples: Cambridge FCE A–C, IELTS 5.5–6.5, TOEFL iBT 72–94, TOEFL ITP 543+. Certificate must be no more than two years old. Approved school/university medium-of-instruction evidence may qualify. Duolingo and DAAD language certificates are not accepted.
selection: No Numerus Clausus. Every applicant who satisfies all admission criteria and applies is offered a place; applicable aptitude cutoffs are rigid.
deadline: Starts every October. Direct campus enrolment for German/EEA-system qualifications is from June; IB and other applicable non-EEA routes apply through uni-assist by 15 July. Results date: NOT PUBLISHED.
feeEU: No conventional tuition fee; semester contribution €126.90 for winter 2026/27. Direct-route application fee: NOT PUBLISHED.
feeNonEU: No conventional tuition fee; semester contribution €126.90 for winter 2026/27. Applicable uni-assist route: €75 first course and €30 each additional course in the same semester.
liveLo: NOT PUBLISHED — no single low monthly total. Official component ranges are published separately; the €992/month amount is a proof-of-funds rule, not a cost forecast.
liveHi: NOT PUBLISHED — no single high monthly total. Official component ranges vary by accommodation, age, insurance and lifestyle.
scholarships: Competitive funding includes the Deutschlandstipendium for socially engaged international students with excellent grades; no full-funding guarantee.
visa: EU citizens are exempt from the pre-travel student-visa requirement; other students generally apply to the responsible German mission before travelling, subject to official nationality-specific exceptions.
apply: German/EEA school-system qualification: enrol directly in the University campus portal from June. IB and other non-EEA school-system routes: apply through uni-assist by 15 July; the University does not use a VPD.
notes: There is no German requirement for enrolment. Students who do not already speak German must take German language classes that count toward the degree. Programme has operated since October 2025 and starts each October. Essays, recommendations and interviews: NOT PUBLISHED.
exact_quote: You can complete the entire programme in English. For the first semesters, you can also attend lectures in German if you wish.

alevel: NOT PUBLISHED — no programme-specific A-Level grades. Final, recognised A-Level documents must establish a German-equivalent university entrance qualification; provisional statements are not accepted.
cbse: NOT PUBLISHED — no CBSE percentage. German-equivalent university entrance qualification is assessed; India-based qualifications require APS unless an official exception applies.
isc: NOT PUBLISHED — no ISC percentage. German-equivalent university entrance qualification is assessed; India-based qualifications require APS unless an official exception applies.
other: Standardised tests: NOT PUBLISHED — official programme admissions list a German-equivalent university entrance qualification and English B2; no SAT, ACT or TestAS requirement is stated. Mandatory semester abroad forms part of the curriculum.

liveHi: NOT PUBLISHED — FAU states that monthly outgoings vary greatly and publishes no single maximum.

visa: EU citizens are exempt from the pre-travel student-visa requirement; other students generally apply to the responsible German mission before travelling, subject to official nationality-specific exceptions.

documents_required: School-leaving certificate, Degree certificates and transcripts, Language proficiency, Curriculum Vitae, Letter of motivation, Valid identity document
